sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You emphasise both your skilled team and our long relationship; it sounds like continuity is central to what you want to protect. We value that partnership and want an agreement that supports sustainable production while reflecting the actual cost impact of the wage movement you identified. How could greater contractual certainty help you bring those interests together?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 48.92 per unit, 60 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei

move.body:
Dear your company team,

You welcome the planning security of our commitment while asking for the figures behind our offer—it sounds like transparency matters alongside continuity. We respect the confidentiality of your calculation and want an explainable adjustment that sustains our long-standing partnership. What external cost benchmarks would you regard as a fair basis for assessing the adjustment together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 49.23 per unit, 60 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to deal with our valued partners in the region. As a traditional family-run foundry, we deeply value our shared history and long relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. 

We have made every effort to accommodate your requests, but we must hold our price at €50.40. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Please understand that this represents our final offer (letztes Angebot) for the 24-month agreement starting 1 January 2027 with 60-day payment terms. 

Our complete Angebot is a price of €50.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer stays valid for 7 days. Please decide if we may move forward together on these terms.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei

Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
